The Goron spice used in this pilaf has given it a rich, spicy aroma.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Curry Pilaf is made by [[Cooking]] [[Hylian Rice]], a [[Bird Egg]], [[Goat Butter]], and [[Goron Spice]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. They restore four of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s when eaten, but they can also be sold for 40 [[Rupee]]s. The Goron Spice used to make these pilafs gives them a rich, spicy aroma. By adding a fifth [[Ingredient]], several different variations of Curry Pilaf can be made: * '''Hearty Curry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Curry Pilaf}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The Goron spice used in this pilaf has given it a rich, spicy aroma.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty Ingredients. Eating this will completely restore all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum Hearts. They are also worth 60 Rupees when sold. * '''Energizing Curry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Curry Pilaf}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The Goron spice used in this pilaf has given it a rich, spicy aroma.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing Ingredients. When eaten, these pilafs will replenish a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. They heal four of Link's Hearts, and they sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Enduring Curry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Curry Pilaf}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The Goron spice used in this pilaf has given it a rich, spicy aroma.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding either [[Endura Carrot]]s or [[Endura Shroom]]s. Consuming these [[Meal]]s will completely replenish and overfill Link's Stamina Wheel. They restore nine of Link's Hearts, but they can also sell for 60 Rupees. * '''Hasty Curry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Curry Pilaf}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The Goron spice used in this pilaf has given it a rich, spicy aroma.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding speed-related Ingredients. Eating one will temporarily boost Link's movement speed. They heal for five Hearts, and they can be sold for 50 Rupees. * '''Spicy Curry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Curry Pilaf}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The Goron spice used in this pilaf has given it a rich, spicy aroma.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy Ingredients. When eaten, they will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] for a short period of time. They heal eight of his Hearts and sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Electro Curry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Curry Pilaf}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
The Goron spice used in this pilaf has given it a rich, spicy aroma.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electricity-related Ingredients. If they are eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. They heal eight of Link's Hearts, but they can be sold for 50 Rupees. * '''Mighty Curry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Curry Pilaf}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The Goron spice used in this pilaf has given it a rich, spicy aroma.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding attack-boosting Ingredients. Eating one of these pilafs will temporarily boost Link's attack power. They restore five Hearts and sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Tough Curry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Curry Pilaf}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The Goron spice used in this pilaf has given it a rich, spicy aroma.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding defensive Ingredients. When consumed, Link's [[Defense]] will be temporarily increased. They replenish five Hearts in Link's Life Gauge, and they sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Sneaky Curry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Curry Pilaf}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
The Goron spice used in this pilaf has given it a rich, spicy aroma.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding [[Stealth]]-boosting Ingredients. Eating one will increase Link's Stealth abilities for a short time. They heal five of Link's Hearts and sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Chilly Curry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Curry Pilaf}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The Goron spice used in this pilaf has given it a rich, spicy aroma.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using cold Ingredients. When eaten, Link will temporarily gain one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. They restore five Hearts and sell for 50 Rupees. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Gourmet Poultry Pilaf * Meal * Poultry Pilaf * Prime Poultry Pilaf }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Curries, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
